meta.description: Enter your website. ScanAxe learns your business, watches buying signals, scores every lead, writes a personal message for each one and runs your outreach on autopilot or with your approval.

hero.badge: For B2B teams · Autopilot or Copilot
hero.title: Your AI sales agent finds the people ready to buy, and reaches out for you.
hero.lead: Enter your website. The agent learns your business, builds your ideal customer profile and watches for buying signals: who is engaging with your topics and competitors, who just changed jobs, which companies just raised money or are hiring. It scores every lead, writes a personal message for each one, and runs your LinkedIn and email outreach on autopilot, or waits for your approval.

problem.title: Cold lists are slow. Blind automation is risky.
problem.lead: Most teams either spend hours finding the right people by hand, or hand their reputation to tools that blast generic messages.

timing.label: Timing
timing.title: You find out too late
timing.body: By the time a company shows up on a static list, the moment it was ready to talk has often passed.

manual.label: Manual work
manual.title: Hours lost to research
manual.body: Checking profiles, posts, news and careers pages by hand, then writing every first message from scratch.

risk.label: Reputation
risk.title: Automation that embarrasses you
risk.body: Generic sequencers send duplicates, keep messaging after someone replies and ignore local rules. Your name pays for it.

how.title: From your website to conversations, in four steps.

define.title: Enter your website
define.body: The agent learns what you sell and proposes your ideal customer profile: industries, company size, regions and roles. You adjust it.

detect.title: Watch buying signals
detect.body: It tracks the signals you choose for people and companies that match your profile.

score.title: Score and write
score.body: Each lead gets a score with plain reasons and the evidence behind it, plus a message written for that person and that reason.

approve.title: Autopilot or Copilot
approve.body: Let approved rules send automatically, or review each message first. Either way, the safety rules below always apply.

signals.title: Signals that someone may be ready to buy, each with its evidence.
signals.lead: Not a static list: every lead appears because something happened, and the card shows what and when.

engagement.title: Your own audience
engagement.body: People engaging with your company page and your team's posts, through your own connected account.

topics.title: Topics and competitors
topics.body: People engaging with posts about the topics, pain points or competitors you choose.
topics.example: Commented on a competitor's launch post

jobChange.title: Job changes
jobChange.body: New decision-makers who just started a role and are setting their priorities.
jobChange.example: New Head of Operations, 3 weeks ago

funding.title: Funding
funding.body: Companies that recently raised money and are likely to invest.

hiring.title: Hiring
hiring.body: Companies hiring for the teams your product or service supports.

lookalike.title: Lookalikes
lookalike.body: People and companies similar to your best customers, to keep the pipeline full.
lookalike.example: Same profile as your top 3 accounts

review.title: One card. Everything you need to decide.
review.reason1: Commented on a post about your category 2 days ago
review.reason2: Started as Head of Revenue Operations 5 weeks ago
review.subject: Your first 90 days in RevOps
review.draft: Hi —, congratulations on the new role. I saw your comment on pipeline forecasting and that Northstar is growing its sales team. We help teams like yours spot buyers earlier. Would a short call to compare notes be useful?
review.note: In Copilot mode nothing is sent until someone clicks Approve.

safety.title: Outreach that protects your reputation.
safety.lead: Autopilot or Copilot, the same rules apply to every message.

approval.title: Autopilot or Copilot
approval.body: Choose per agent: send automatically within your rules, or approve each message. What you approve is exactly what is sent.

dedupe.title: No duplicates, no send after a reply
dedupe.body: A message is never sent twice, never after the person replies, and two teammates don't contact the same person.

rules.title: Per-country rules
rules.body: Sending follows the rules of the recipient's country, within conservative daily limits. When the country is unknown, the strictest rules apply.

audience.title: Made for anyone selling B2B.
audience.lead: Founders, sales teams and agencies who want conversations, not lists.

faq.title: Clear answers on signals, control and compliance.

auto.q: Can ScanAxe send without my approval?
auto.a: Only if you choose Autopilot for an agent, and only within the rules you set. In Copilot mode every message waits for a person to approve it. In both modes, nothing is sent twice or after a reply.

dedupe.q: How do you stop two teammates contacting the same person?
dedupe.a: When a lead is taken into a campaign, it's claimed across your workspace for a cooldown period you control.

data.q: Where do the signals come from?
data.a: From your own connected LinkedIn account (engagement with your page, posts, chosen topics and competitors), plus public company information such as job postings and funding news. Every card shows the evidence and when it was found. We don't use scraping pools or shared accounts.

linkedin.q: Is my LinkedIn account at risk?
linkedin.a: ScanAxe only works with your own accounts, within conservative daily limits for reading and sending, and you can always send manually. We never use shared, fake or rented accounts.

compliance.a: Each contact is matched to a country profile that decides what's allowed, when, and with what opt-out wording. Unknown country means the strictest profile. Our rules are being reviewed by legal counsel before launch.

lists.q: Can we upload our customer and off-limits lists?
lists.a: Yes. Upload customers, off-limits companies and do-not-contact lists so they never reach a campaign.

language.a: English and Arabic, including right-to-left layouts. Messages can be written in the language of the recipient.
